papers.title: Evidential Uncertainty Quantification: A Variance-Based Perspective
papers.abstract: Uncertainty quantification of deep neural networks has become an active field of research and plays a crucial role in various downstream tasks such as active learning. Recent advances in evidential deep learning shed light on the direct quantification of aleatoric and epistemic uncertainties with a single forward pass of the model. Most traditional approaches adopt an entropy-based method to derive evidential uncertainty in classification, quantifying uncertainty at the sample level. However, the variance-based method that has been widely applied in regression problems is seldom used in the classification setting. In this work, we adapt the variance-based approach from regression to classification, quantifying classification uncertainty at the class level. The variance decomposition technique in regression is extended to class covariance decomposition in classification based on the law of total covariance, and the class correlation is also derived from the covariance. Experiments on cross-domain datasets are conducted to illustrate that the variance-based approach not only results in similar accuracy as the entropy-based one in active domain adaptation but also brings information about class-wise uncertainties as well as between-class correlations. The code is available at https://github.com/KerryDRX/EvidentialADA. This alternative means of evidential uncertainty quantification will give researchers more options when class uncertainties and correlations are important in their applications.

llm.relevance_to_user: 与有限元代理建模方向无关，仅涉及分类任务的证据不确定性量化，未涉及计算昂贵的仿真或生物力学设计。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address surrogate modeling for expensive simulations, does not involve FEA, constraints, or optimization, and lacks any connection to implant/biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有分类不确定性量化方法主要基于熵，缺乏类级方差分解。
summary_zh.method: 将回归中的方差分解扩展为分类中的类协方差分解，基于总协方差定律。
summary_zh.result: 方差法在主动域适应中取得与熵法相似精度，并提供类级不确定性和类间相关性。
summary_zh.validation: 在跨域数据集上进行实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: Existing evidential uncertainty quantification for classification focuses on sample-level entropy, lacking class-level variance-based decomposition.
summary_en.method: The variance decomposition from regression is adapted to classification by deriving class covariance decomposition using the law of total covariance.
summary_en.result: The variance-based approach achieves comparable accuracy to entropy-based methods in active domain adaptation while providing class-wise uncertainties and between-class correlations.
summary_en.validation: Experiments are conducted on cross-domain datasets for active domain adaptation tasks.

papers.title: LABCAT: Locally adaptive Bayesian optimization using principal-component-aligned trust regions
papers.abstract: Bayesian optimization (BO) is a popular method for optimizing expensive black-box functions. BO has several well-documented shortcomings, including computational slowdown with longer optimization runs, poor suitability for non-stationary or ill-conditioned objective functions, and poor convergence characteristics. Several algorithms have been proposed that incorporate local strategies, such as trust regions, into BO to mitigate these limitations; however, none address all of them satisfactorily. To address these shortcomings, we propose the LABCAT algorithm, which extends trust-region-based BO by adding a rotation aligning the trust region with the weighted principal components and an adaptive rescaling strategy based on the length-scales of a local Gaussian process surrogate model with automatic relevance determination. Through extensive numerical experiments using a set of synthetic test functions and the well-known COCO benchmarking software, we show that the LABCAT algorithm outperforms several state-of-the-art BO and other black-box optimization algorithms.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文提出一种改进的贝叶斯优化算法，可应用于替代模型的采样优化，但未涉及约束处理或生物力学领域。
llm.why_not_core: No constraint handling, no uncertainty quantification beyond GP length-scales, and no validation on FEA or biomechanics problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决贝叶斯优化在非平稳、病态目标函数上的局限性。
summary_zh.method: 提出LABCAT算法，通过主成分对齐信任区域和自适应缩放改进局部优化。
summary_zh.result: 在合成函数和COCO基准上优于多种先进优化算法。
summary_zh.validation: 基于标准测试函数和COCO软件进行数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: To address shortcomings of Bayesian optimization including poor convergence on non-stationary or ill-conditioned functions.
summary_en.method: Proposes LABCAT, which rotates trust regions using weighted principal components and adapts their scale based on local GP length-scales with ARD.
summary_en.result: Outperforms several state-of-the-art black-box optimization algorithms on synthetic functions and the COCO benchmark.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on standard test functions and the COCO benchmarking software.

papers.title: Uncertainty quantification for noisy inputs-outputs in physics-informed neural networks and neural operators
papers.abstract: Uncertainty quantification (UQ) in scientific machine learning (SciML) becomes increasingly critical as neural networks (NNs) are being widely adopted in addressing complex problems across various scientific disciplines. Representative SciML models are physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) and neural operators (NOs). While UQ in SciML has been increasingly investigated in recent years, very few works have focused on addressing the uncertainty caused by the noisy inputs, such as spatial-temporal coordinates in PINNs and input functions in NOs. The presence of noise in the inputs of the models can pose significantly more challenges compared to noise in the outputs of the models, primarily due to the inherent nonlinearity of most SciML algorithms. As a result, UQ for noisy inputs becomes a crucial factor for reliable and trustworthy deployment of these models in applications involving physical knowledge. To this end, we introduce a Bayesian approach to quantify uncertainty arising from noisy inputs-outputs in PINNs and NOs. We show that this approach can be seamlessly integrated into PINNs and NOs, when they are employed to encode the physical information. PINNs incorporate physics by including physics-informed terms via automatic differentiation, either in the loss function or the likelihood, and often take as input the spatial-temporal coordinate. Therefore, the present method equips PINNs with the capability to address problems where the observed coordinate is subject to noise. On the other hand, pretrained NOs are also commonly employed as equation-free surrogates in solving differential equations and Bayesian inverse problems, in which they take functions as inputs. The proposed approach enables them to handle noisy measurements for both input and output functions with UQ.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文直接针对代理模型（PINNs和神经算子）中的不确定性量化问题，尤其是噪声输入带来的挑战，对提高仿真代理的可靠性和可转移性至关重要。
llm.why_not_core: It does not apply the UQ method to implant or biomechanics design problems; it only demonstrates on abstract PDE benchmarks.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有PINNs和神经算子的UQ工作很少考虑噪声输入，这限制了其在物理应用中的可靠性。
summary_zh.method: 提出一种贝叶斯方法，将噪声输入-输出的不确定性量化无缝集成到PINNs和神经算子中。
summary_zh.result: 该方法能处理坐标噪声和函数噪声，同时保持物理信息编码能力。
summary_zh.validation: 在多个基准问题上验证了噪声输入下的不确定性量化效果。

summary_en.motivation: Existing uncertainty quantification methods for PINNs and neural operators largely neglect noise in inputs, hindering reliable deployment in physical applications.
summary_en.method: A Bayesian framework is introduced to quantify uncertainty from noisy inputs and outputs, seamlessly integrated into PINNs and neural operators while preserving physics encoding.
summary_en.result: The proposed approach handles both coordinate noise (PINNs) and input function noise (neural operators) with validated uncertainty estimates.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on numerical benchmark problems involving noisy inputs and outputs for both PINNs and neural operators.

papers.title: BOIS: Bayesian Optimization of Interconnected Systems
papers.abstract: Bayesian optimization (BO) has proven to be an effective paradigm for the global optimization of expensive-to-sample systems. One of the main advantages of BO is its use of Gaussian processes (GPs) to characterize model uncertainty which can be leveraged to guide the learning and search process. However, BO typically treats systems as black-boxes and this limits the ability to exploit structural knowledge (e.g., physics and sparse interconnections). Composite functions of the form $f(x, y(x))$, wherein GP modeling is shifted from the performance function $f$ to an intermediate function $y$, offer an avenue for exploiting structural knowledge. However, the use of composite functions in a BO framework is complicated by the need to generate a probability density for $f$ from the Gaussian density of $y$ calculated by the GP (e.g., when $f$ is nonlinear it is not possible to obtain a closed-form expression). Previous work has handled this issue using sampling techniques; these are easy to implement and flexible but are computationally intensive. In this work, we introduce a new paradigm which allows for the efficient use of composite functions in BO; this uses adaptive linearizations of $f$ to obtain closed-form expressions for the statistical moments of the composite function. We show that this simple approach (which we call BOIS) enables the exploitation of structural knowledge, such as that arising in interconnected systems as well as systems that embed multiple GP models and combinations of physics and GP models. Using a chemical process optimization case study, we benchmark the effectiveness of BOIS against standard BO and sampling approaches. Our results indicate that BOIS achieves performance gains and accurately captures the statistics of composite functions.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该方法可转移到植入物/生物力学设计的代理建模和不确定性量化，但未涉及约束处理或具体生物医学验证。
llm.why_not_core: It does not handle constraints (only unconstrained optimization), and the validation is on a chemical process case study without implant or biomechanics context.

summary_zh.motivation: 标准BO将系统视为黑盒，无法利用结构知识；复合函数BO存在采样计算量大的问题。
summary_zh.method: 提出自适应线性化方法，获得复合函数统计矩的闭式表达式，从而高效利用结构知识。
summary_zh.result: 在化学过程优化案例中，BOIS在性能上优于标准BO和采样方法，并准确捕捉复合函数统计数据。
summary_zh.validation: 通过与标准BO和采样方法对比的数值案例验证。

summary_en.motivation: Standard Bayesian optimization treats systems as black boxes, failing to exploit structural knowledge; composite function approaches suffer from high sampling cost.
summary_en.method: This work introduces adaptive linearizations of the composite function to obtain closed-form statistical moments, enabling efficient exploitation of structural knowledge in BO.
summary_en.result: In a chemical process optimization case study, BOIS outperforms standard BO and sampling approaches, accurately capturing the statistics of composite functions.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated through numerical benchmarking against standard BO and sampling approaches on a chemical process case study.
